Several integrations were updated to tolerate this via `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` (e.g., Zoom/Google/Office365), but `packages/app-store/webex/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts` was only changed to route through `refreshOAuthTokens` and still hands the response into the existing `handleWebexResponse(...)` path without any new minimal-response parsing. The finding’s exact claim about `webexRefreshedTokenSchema` requirements and the guaranteed rejection can’t be verified from the shown diff (the schema/parsing code isn’t included here), but the diff does show Webex is not updated in the same way as others for the documented minimal token response, which is a concrete, diff-grounded completeness risk for sync mode.
